projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
An analytics dashboard that unifies three data domains into a single interface: (1) customer data ingested and processed from CSV files, (2) application log analysis for error rates, throughput and anomaly detection, and (3) interactive visualization components (KPI cards, time-series charts, breakdowns) rendered in a responsive dashboard layout.

Scope covers ingestion and validation, data cleaning and normalization, an aggregation/metrics layer, a log parsing and analytics pipeline, a reusable chart component library, API endpoints to serve processed metrics, frontend integration, end-to-end testing, and deployment with basic monitoring.

Success criteria: verified data quality on ingestion, sub-second dashboard metric queries for typical volumes, chart components that are reusable and accessible, and an end-to-end tested, deployable dashboard.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, visualization, logs

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: Deliver a trustworthy customer-data foundation for the dashboard. Covers the CSV data contract, ingestion and validation, cleaning/normalization, the aggregation layer that produces dashboard metrics, and test coverage for the pipeline. Exit criteria: incoming customer CSVs are schema-validated, rejected rows are reported with reasons, and dashboard-ready customer metrics are queryable.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Turn raw application logs into analysable metrics. Covers the log format specification, a resilient parser, error-rate and anomaly aggregation, a metrics endpoint over log-derived data, and pipeline tests. Exit criteria: logs parse at volume with malformed lines isolated rather than failing the batch, and error-rate/throughput/anomaly metrics are available for the dashboard.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Visualization Components
tasks.details: Build the reusable frontend building blocks of the dashboard. Covers UX/component architecture, the base chart library, KPI summary cards, dashboard layout with filtering, and accessibility/responsive polish. Exit criteria: components render with real-shaped data, are reusable across data domains, and pass accessibility checks on desktop and mobile viewports.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Integration, Testing & Deployment
tasks.details: Ship the dashboard as a working product. Covers the metrics API surface, wiring the frontend to live APIs, end-to-end testing, and deployment with monitoring. Exit criteria: a deployed dashboard serving both customer and log metrics, covered by E2E tests, with baseline alerting and a documented runbook.

tasks.name: Define customer CSV schema and data contract
tasks.details: Document every column in the incoming customer CSV files: name, data type, required/optional, allowed values, and business meaning. Capture encoding, delimiter, header conventions and max expected file size/row count. Produce a written data contract that the ingestion and validation task will be coded against, and get it confirmed with whoever owns the customer export.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion and validation module
tasks.details: Implement file discovery/upload handling, streaming parse (no full-file load for large inputs), and row-level validation against the data contract: type checks, required fields, date/currency formats, duplicate customer IDs. Invalid rows must be captured to a quarantine output with an explicit reason rather than aborting the run. Emit a run summary with counts of read, accepted and rejected rows.

tasks.name: Implement data cleaning and normalization
tasks.details: Standardize accepted records: trim whitespace, normalize casing for categorical fields, coerce dates/currencies to canonical types and timezone, map country/plan values to a controlled vocabulary, and deduplicate customers using a documented merge rule. Persist cleaning decisions in a log so metric discrepancies can be traced back to source rows.

tasks.name: Build customer metrics aggregation layer
tasks.details: Compute the dashboard's customer metrics from cleaned data: total and active customers, new customers per period, churn rate, revenue and average revenue per customer, plus breakdowns by plan, country and signup cohort. Materialize results into a storage table/queryable form with a consistent schema so the API and charts can consume them without recomputation.

tasks.name: Add CSV pipeline test suite and data-quality report
tasks.details: Cover the pipeline with fixture-based tests: valid file, messy-but-recoverable file, structurally broken file, duplicates and large-file throughput. Verify metric outputs against hand-calculated expected values. Add an automated data-quality report (rejection rate, null rate per column, duplicate rate, row counts per run) that surfaces degradation instead of silently losing data.

tasks.name: Document log format and define parsing spec
tasks.details: Inventory the application log sources and their formats (structured JSON vs. plaintext line formats, timestamps/timezones, severity levels, request IDs, stack traces spanning multiple lines). Write a parsing spec covering fields to extract, canonical severity mapping, and how multiline entries are joined. Include 10-20 representative sample lines per source, sanitized of customer data.

tasks.name: Build resilient log parser with malformed-line quarantine
tasks.details: Implement a streaming parser that extracts timestamp, severity, service, endpoint, status code, latency and message from each log entry, handling multiline stack traces and mixed formats. Unparseable lines must be written to a quarantine bucket with the original line and an error reason — a single bad line must never fail a batch. Target sustained throughput of at least 10k lines/second on a dev machine.

tasks.name: Implement error-rate and throughput aggregation
tasks.details: Aggregate parsed logs into time-bucketed metric series: request counts, error counts by severity and status class, error rate as a percentage, p50/p95/p99 latency, and top failing endpoints. Bucket by minute/hour/day with a documented timezone. Materialize into the same queryable metrics store shape used by the customer metrics so the API stays uniform.

tasks.name: Implement anomaly detection for log metrics
tasks.details: Flag unusual behaviour in the log metric series — error-rate spikes and traffic drops — using a simple, explainable method (rolling baseline with a configurable deviation threshold, optionally seasonal comparison). Output anomaly records with metric, window, observed vs. expected value and severity, and expose them for the dashboard's alert/annotation panel. Keep thresholds configurable and document the false-positive tradeoffs.

tasks.name: Add log pipeline test suite with sample log corpus
tasks.details: Build a test corpus of realistic log files: well-formed entries, mixed formats, truncated final lines, multiline stack traces, and deliberately corrupt lines. Test parse correctness, quarantine behaviour, aggregation math against hand-computed values, and anomaly detection against synthetic spikes. Add a throughput benchmark test so regressions in parsing speed are caught.

tasks.name: Design dashboard UX and component architecture
tasks.details: Sketch the dashboard information architecture: which panels exist, their priority, and how customer metrics and log metrics are grouped. Define the component inventory and their props/contracts (KPI card, line/area chart, bar breakdown, table, filter bar, anomaly annotations), the shared data shape passed into charts, and the state management approach for filters. Deliver wireframes plus a short architecture note.

tasks.name: Build base chart component library
tasks.details: Implement the core chart primitives on the chosen charting library: line/area chart for time series, bar chart for category breakdowns, and a data table with sorting. Each component needs loading, empty, error and partial-data states, responsive sizing, consistent tooltip/axis formatting, and a typed props interface. Include Storybook (or equivalent) examples with mock data for each variant.

tasks.name: Build KPI summary card components
tasks.details: Create KPI cards showing a headline value, label, period-over-period delta with direction indicator, and optional sparkline. Support number/currency/percentage formatting, correct handling of missing or zero data, and a colour-blind-safe positive/negative palette. Cover with component tests and examples for each metric type (customers, revenue, error rate, latency).

tasks.name: Build dashboard layout and filter controls
tasks.details: Assemble the dashboard shell: responsive grid layout, section headers, and a filter bar with date-range presets (7/30/90 days, custom), service selector and plan/country filters. Filters must drive a single shared state that all panels read, persist in the URL for shareable views, and debounce so changing filters doesn't fire duplicate requests.

tasks.name: Accessibility and responsive polish pass
tasks.details: Make every panel usable without a mouse and on small screens: semantic markup and heading order, labelled form controls, keyboard-navigable charts with a table fallback, sufficient colour contrast, focus states, and reduced-motion support. Verify layout at mobile/tablet/desktop breakpoints and run an automated accessibility audit with zero critical violations.

tasks.name: Build metrics API endpoints
tasks.details: Expose the materialized metrics over HTTP: endpoints for customer KPIs and breakdowns, log error-rate/throughput/latency series, and anomaly records. Support the filter set from the dashboard (date range, service, plan, country) with validated query params, a documented JSON response envelope, pagination where relevant, and caching headers. Include response-time targets and API contract tests.

tasks.name: Wire frontend components to live metrics APIs
tasks.details: Replace mock data in the dashboard panels with real API calls. Add a data-fetching layer with request cancellation, retry/backoff, and loading/error states wired to each panel; map filter state into query parameters; handle empty ranges gracefully. Verify each panel renders identical values to the API response and that changing filters refreshes all panels exactly once.

tasks.name: Write end-to-end dashboard test suite
tasks.details: Automate the critical user journeys in a browser: load the dashboard, apply a date-range and service filter, confirm KPI cards and charts update, switch to an empty range and see the empty state, and recover from an API error. Seed a deterministic fixture dataset so assertions on displayed numbers are stable. Run the suite in CI against a built app with a test database.

tasks.name: Set up deployment pipeline and monitoring
tasks.details: Containerize the app and pipelines, and add a CI/CD workflow that runs unit, integration, E2E and accessibility checks before deploying to a staging then production environment. Configure scheduled runs of the CSV and log pipelines. Add monitoring: uptime and error-rate alerts on the dashboard/API, pipeline failure alerts, and basic dashboards for job duration and data freshness.

tasks.name: Write runbook and handover documentation
tasks.details: Document how to run and operate the dashboard: architecture overview, environment variables, how to trigger and re-run the CSV and log pipelines, where quarantine/rejected data lands and how to triage it, how to tune anomaly thresholds, alert response steps, and known limitations. Include a metric definitions glossary so dashboard numbers are unambiguous.

tasks.name: Implement streaming CSV reader and row parser
tasks.details: Build the read path only: locate/accept uploaded files, stream rows without loading the whole file into memory, handle encoding quirks and quoted fields with embedded delimiters/newlines, and emit raw rows plus a per-file parse summary. No business validation rules here — just getting clean raw row objects out reliably.

tasks.name: Implement validation rules and rejection reporting
tasks.details: Apply the data contract to parsed rows: required fields, type coercion checks, date/currency formats, allowed-value sets and duplicate customer IDs. Write every rejected row to a quarantine output with its row number and a specific reason code, and emit accepted/rejected counts for the run summary.

tasks.name: Compute core customer KPI metrics
tasks.details: Implement the scalar KPI calculations over cleaned customers: total customers, active customers, new customers per period, churn rate, total revenue and average revenue per customer. Handle period boundary definitions explicitly and guard against divide-by-zero on empty periods.

tasks.name: Build dimensional breakdowns and metrics materialization
tasks.details: Add the grouped metrics the charts need — by plan, country and signup cohort — then materialize all KPI and breakdown results into the shared metrics store schema (metric name, dimension keys, period, value) so the API can read precomputed values instead of recalculating per request.

tasks.name: Implement log line tokenizer and field extraction
tasks.details: Build the happy-path parser: detect entry boundaries, handle JSON and plaintext line formats, join multiline stack traces to their parent entry, and extract timestamp, severity, service, endpoint, status code, latency and message into a typed record. Cover the formats documented in the parsing spec.

tasks.name: Add malformed-line quarantine and batch resilience
tasks.details: Harden the parser for production data: catch per-entry parse failures, route them to a quarantine output with the original line and reason, continue processing the rest of the batch, and emit parse-rate/error-rate counters. Add the streaming throughput benchmark against the 10k lines/second target.
